QuestInfo.name: Unidentified Spaceship
QuestInfo.0: An unidentified spaceship has crashed in Maple World. Talk to #b#p9250156##k, who is in Henesys, Orbis, Ludibrium, and Omega Sector, and go to the spaceship crash site.
QuestInfo.1: A spaceship presumably belonging to aliens has crash landed in Maple World. An organization called the OSSS seems to be investigating it. Investigate the cube-shaped spaceship and defeat the leader of the aliens before returning to #b#p9250154##k.
QuestInfo.2: You explored the alien cube and defeated the Ultimate Visitor.\r\nBut why do you feel as if you've been here before...

0.0: Hello, I'm Wynn, an OSSS Researcher. Are you here because you heard the news?\r\n#L0##bYes. Whoa! A spaceship really did crash!#l\n#k
0.1: We've done a preliminary investigation of the interior. The beings, which we presume to be aliens, are inside and they seem to have a leader commanding them.\r\n#L0##bBeings presumed to be aliens...? What could they possibly want from us?#l\n#k
0.2:
That's what I want to find out. We need people to go in and investigate. Interested?
#L0##bYes. That's why I'm here!#l
#L1#Nah, sounds dangerous.#l
#k
0.3: You are very brave. \r\nSo, will you accept?

yes.0: Thank you. Please talk to me again and I will let you in.
yes.1: Once you've investigated the Cube, don't forget to report back.

1.0: Have you finished exploring the Spaceship?\r\n#L0##bYes. I fought quite a few aliens. In the last cube, I encountered a very powerful alien.#l\n#k
1.1: Were you able to find out anything about their purpose?\r\n#L0##bNo. They refused to talk. The strange thing is... I felt like I've been there before.#l\n#k
1.2: You did?\r\nThat is strange...I also feel as if I've experienced this before. Others have said the same.\r\nIt's as if we all had the same dream.

yes.0: In any case, thank you. You've been a lot of help.\r\nYou can re-enter anytime you wish.
